dedupe_keys.name: time explicit modelling of disruption recovery and adaptation of an interdependent road electricity system

description: Time-explicit modelling of disruption, recovery and adaptation of an interdependent road-electricity system is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Edgar Daniel Peregrina Gonzalez, Lieke Meijer (Deltares). A time‑explicit disruption and recovery model to represent the coupled behaviour of electricity substations and the road network during and after a pluvial flooding event. The model simulates, at each hourly timestep, flood exposure, substation failure, road accessibility, repair crew allocation, and recovery, and translates these processes into spatially distributed impacts. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
